items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Rouse -- we formed a band, a six-piece band. We worked at this famous club... called the Crystal Caverns. ... when I had the little band with Charlie Rouse and Phil Phillips and Osie Johnson and Tommy Potter and Harry Curtis... This was 1942.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think Marjorie Hyams. And Chuck Wayne was the guitarist. At that time, Oscar Moore had just left Nat Cole's group, and he was with his brother's group. They had aa group called The Four Blazers, that featured Charlie Rouse.

Anyway, it turned out to be a very enjoyable engagement that we had there. And we stayed there for quite a few months, up until they booked Billie Holiday in. And for some reason (I don't know exactly what; there was a reason given), Billie Holiday could not make the date. Well, everybody was
